messages:
mika-csm: Heads-up: PolarisMed trial runs a live demo next Tue in APAC. They're hitting sustained bursts in staging and asked for a short-lived regional QPS increase + allowlist for a cloud peering IP. Renewal conversation scheduled in 10 days.
paul-support: Can we do a controlled bump (60 -> 240 qps) for 6 hours around demo time? They'll also request passthrough logs to their SIEM via a managed tunnel.
sam-eng: We can do the QPS window and add the CIDR. For logs, we'd prefer S3 delivery + signed webhook to their SIEM rather than an SSH tunnel. Does Polaris accept that? also, for cache warm we can run a cold-warm script that seeds top-5 prefixes 60m before demo. Need their top prompts.
paul-support: Polaris prefers webhook. They'll accept S3 + webhook for delivery. CIDR they gave is 198.51.100.0/24. Demo window: 2026-05-11T08:00Z -> 2026-05-11T14:00Z (6h). Auto-revoke after.
ops-rami: netops checklist: need exact account id, region tag, and justification note for security audit. Also confirm whether this is staging or prod tenancy. We prefer staging for temp bumps.
mika-csm: account: polaris-med (acct-pol-9921). staging tenancy. justification: customer live demo for enterprise POC, partner observing. I'll add to the ticket.
sam-eng: plan:
1) apply allowlist 198.51.100.0/24 to apac-proxy-staging
2) bump account QPS 60 -> 240 during window
3) queue cache-seed job (seed-top5) at 2026-05-11T07:00Z
4) enable request-level trace ids and s3 log delivery + signed webhook to Polaris SIEM

ops-rami: scheduling change. netops-bot please create scheduled revoke and attach audit note. infra-bot please stage s3+webhook delivery creds.
netops-bot: @ops-rami scheduled: revoke_job=rev-330222. Scheduled revoke at 2026-05-11T14:05Z. Audit note linked: ticket POL-9921-DEMO.
infra-bot: S3 bucket polaris-med-logs-staging created (retention 14d). webhook secret created and sent to secure-vault (vault://secrets/pol-9921/webhook).
sam-eng: deploying change now. snippet:
```
# staging demo config
account: acct-pol-9921
region: apac-sg-staging
qps: 240
allowlist: [198.51.100.0/24]
duration: 6h
logs: s3://polaris-med-logs-staging + webhook
```
ops-rami: APPLY DONE. allowlist added, qps bumped, revoke scheduled. cache seed job queued id=seed-330222. Monitoring hooks enabled.
paul-support: Polaris reports fewer 429s; initial latency up ~30ms during seed but stabilizing. SIEM webhook auth validated.
mika-csm: Great. I'll add this to renewal playbook as a positive demo outcome and flag ask: recommend they adopt prefix caching and longer cache TTLs. follow-up assigned to paul-support to collect demo metrics and record in CSM notes.
paul-support: will post telemetry after end of window. setting alert: if 5xx > 0.5% over 5m, we roll back early.
sam-eng: noted. closing loop: ensure revoke_job fires and we gather post-demo KV hit ratios.
paul-support: Thanks team! :rocket:
